chk_auth_users_credential.name: chk_auth_users_credential
chk_auth_users_credential.value: `auth_users`.`password_hash` IS NOT NULL OR `auth_users`.`email_verified_at` IS NOT NULL

chk_report_target.name: chk_report_target
chk_report_target.value: (`mod_reports`.`target_type` = 'user' AND `mod_reports`.`target_user_id` IS NOT NULL) OR (`mod_reports`.`target_type` = 'listing' AND `mod_reports`.`target_listing_id` IS NOT NULL) OR (`mod_reports`.`target_type` = 'message' AND `mod_reports`.`target_message_id` IS NOT NULL)

chk_sanction_target.name: chk_sanction_target
chk_sanction_target.value: `mod_sanctions`.`user_id` IS NOT NULL OR `mod_sanctions`.`listing_id` IS NOT NULL

chk_profile_budget_range.name: chk_profile_budget_range
chk_profile_budget_range.value: `profile_housing_preferences`.`budget_max` IS NULL OR `profile_housing_preferences`.`budget_min` IS NULL OR `profile_housing_preferences`.`budget_max` >= `profile_housing_preferences`.`budget_min`

chk_profile_age_range.name: chk_profile_age_range
chk_profile_age_range.value: `profile_housing_preferences`.`max_age_pref` IS NULL OR `profile_housing_preferences`.`min_age_pref` IS NULL OR `profile_housing_preferences`.`max_age_pref` >= `profile_housing_preferences`.`min_age_pref`

chk_chat_origin.name: chk_chat_origin
chk_chat_origin.value: `chat_rooms`.`connection_id` IS NOT NULL OR `chat_rooms`.`application_id` IS NOT NULL
